project: Hide Cron / System-Time Utility Topology from Factory Graph UI
description: Hide internal __system_time utility workstations, work types, and states from factory graph UI surfaces while preserving canonical factory data, matching existing timeline topology filtering and resource-hiding test patterns.

context.customerAsk: Various utility workstations and work states appear in the factory graph because they are not hidden. Hide them from the UI and add tests that validate hiding the same way we validate hiding resources—primarily for __system_time (workstation:__system_time:expire, pending, the work type, and related edges).
context.problem: Factory graph observer and editor paths build full topology from the canonical factory definition, so internal cron/system-time entities (__system_time work type, pending state, __system_time:expire utility workstation, and their edges) appear in the UI even though timeline dashboard topology already omits them and customers do not author this plumbing.
context.solution: Introduce a shared customer-display graph topology filter aligned with existing system-time contracts, apply it at graph render boundaries (current-activity layout and factory graph editor React Flow projection), keep canonical factory and timeline snapshot.factory intact, and add direct layout/projection tests modeled on resource-availability hiding.

acceptanceCriteria: Factory graph UI does not render __system_time work type, __system_time:pending work state, or __system_time:expire utility workstation nodes
Rendered graphs omit edges to or from filtered system-time nodes; mixed customer workstations show only public routes
Customer cron workstations and public work types remain visible and interactable
Canonical factory payloads and timeline snapshot.factory retain __system_time data; existing timeline topology omission tests keep passing
Automated tests prove filtered rendered graph output using the resource-hiding test pattern
Typecheck, lint, and tests pass for all touched packages

userStories.title: Shared customer-display graph visibility rules
userStories.description: As a maintainer, I need one authoritative rule set for internal system-time graph entities so observer and editor surfaces hide the same nodes and edges.
acceptanceCriteria: Shared graph visibility module exposes system-time predicates and filterFactoryGraphTopologyForCustomerDisplay aligned with SYSTEM_TIME_* constants in systemTime.ts and pkg/interfaces/factory_config.go
Filter removes __system_time work-type nodes, __system_time work-state nodes, __system_time:expire workstation nodes, and any edges referencing removed node IDs with no orphans
Unit tests cover pure system-time fixtures, mixed public/system-time workstation fixtures, and a case where a normal customer workstation remains
Typecheck passes
Tests pass

userStories.title: Hide system-time topology from current-activity graph layout

acceptanceCriteria: buildCurrentActivityGraphLayoutFromFactory applies the shared customer-display filter before seeding layout nodes and edges

Mixed workstations render without edges to internal pending or expire nodes while keeping public routes

Layout test asserts raw buildFactoryGraphTopologyFromDefinition may contain system-time entities but buildCurrentActivityGraphLayoutFromFactory output must not, following the resource-availability test pattern
Typecheck passes
Tests pass
